title: SpecterInboxConfig
description: Configuration schema for Specter Catch-All Mail & OTP Interceptor Subsystem (~/.specter/inbox/inbox.json)

host.description: Local HTTP webhook server binding host IP

port.description: Local HTTP webhook server listening port

webhook_secret.description: Shared authentication secret token for validating incoming webhooks from Cloudflare Workers

cloud_sync.description: Enable real-time cloud synchronization with Specter Cloud hub

supabase_url.description: Optional custom Supabase Cloud endpoint URL

supabase_anon_key.description: Optional custom Supabase anonymous or publishable client API key

catch_all_domains.description: List of active Catch-All domains monitored by this workstation

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain raw email messages in local SQLite database

default_timeout_secs.description: Default timeout in seconds when awaiting OTP arrival in CLI commands
